tickets.title: Sign-in from new country after failures
Port scan burst at the edge firewall

playbook: 1. Work the queue by priority. Every ticket has its own SLA clock.
2. Investigate before you decide: socsearch, then grep / less the case files in ~/cases.
tp        Attack against a server with a clear external source. Document the IOC:
submit defense <ip> so the firewall team can block it.
fp        Alert fired on expected activity (approved scanner, change ticket).
Close with a note that cites the evidence, then submit defense.
escalate  A user account may be taken over (success after failures from a new
country, odd hours). L2 owns containment. Write the escalation note
(user, IP, country, time window), then submit defense.
4. note <text> attaches your analyst note to the focused ticket. Good notes name the
evidence: IPs, usernames, times. Another analyst should not need to re-investigate.
5. shift shows your queue summary at any time.

shiftBody: Training shift. Three tickets in your queue, three clients, three different right answers.
Work them by priority. Each ticket has its own SLA clock in the left panel.
Loop per ticket: ticket <id>, investigate (socsearch, grep, less), disposition, note, submit defense.
Type defense exit to return to offense.
